fields.staffing: Day shift, single certified operator on duty
fields.narration: STARTEX. This is an exercise. It is 09:00 on Thursday, October 22, 2026. The Riverside Water Treatment Plant is operating under normal conditions. The day shift is in progress, and the control room is manned by a certified operator. All system statuses are green on the HMI. The narrative clock begins.

status.name: SCADA Network
status.note: All controllers responsive, no telemetry loss

fields.facilitatorNote: Confirm all roles have their briefing packets and are seated. This is the baseline state for a cyber-physical incident involving chemical feed tampering. Observe how teams interpret the HMI data versus field reality.
